content:
- name: Verify timeout-minutes in all workflows
  run: |
    missing=0
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      if ! grep -q 'timeout-minutes:' "$f"; then
        echo "Workflow $f does not declare timeout-minutes"
        missing=1
      fi
    done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
      exit 1
    fi
    exit 0
